messages.content: <image>Analyze this satellite image of Patna, Bihar, September 2024.

Extensive inundation is visible along the river's southern bank, covering roughly 35% of the scene. Agricultural plots near the embankment are submerged and several road segments appear interrupted. Water extent is strongly anomalous compared to the September baseline of about 6%.
<image>Locate all flooded areas in this satellite image with bounding boxes.
<image>Analyze the flooding in Jaipur, Rajasthan, March 2024.

Your premise is not supported by this imagery. Water bodies occupy only about 3% of the scene, consistent with the seasonal baseline of 4%. No inundation, standing water, or sediment plumes are detected in urban or peri-urban zones.
